description:
Seo Jung-Won, a scoop reporter who grabs bad guys by the collar. She had a perfect life with intelligence, beauty, and a third-generation chaebol husband. Until her husband's mistress turns up dead. It's shocking to know that her husband, who she thought was a single-mindedly affectionate man, had a mistress, but as she begins to be suspected of being the murderer who killed her, new incidents start to intertwine and entangle Jung-Won like a spider's web as she tries to escape. Jung-Won digs for the truth with her longtime partner Jesus and detective Tae-Heon, who becomes her new partner by accident, and faces unbelievable truths.

(Source: Naver, translated)
